Included evidence

This small bundle accompanies the development findings from 16 October 2026. Files are copied byte-for-byte from the original local runs. No experiments were rerun during the documentation cleanup.

Provenance

The manifest records every source path, byte count and SHA-256 digest. python tools/build_docs.py --check verifies the included files against that manifest without requiring the ignored runs/ directory.

The complete workspace retains additional videos, per-step telemetry, observation/action arrays and source snapshots. Those are not part of this site. The archive retains their relative paths as local artifact references.

The dataset is exploratory: all 14 controlled episodes failed the full pickup criterion, and some earlier comparisons were confounded by graphics startup or scene initialization. See current results before interpreting the raw measurements.
